readers_note: The opening division is followed by one geographic boundary.

sections.heading: Three parts
sections.original: Gallia est omnis divisa in partes tres.
sections.translation: All Gaul is divided into three parts.

sections.heading: River boundary
sections.original: Gallos ab Aquitanis Garumna flumen dividit.
sections.translation: The river Garonne separates the Gauls from the Aquitani.

joins.rationale: The second page begins a separate boundary statement.
